name: Arenas
description: Choose from 12 arena shapes per run: Default, Circle, Hexagon, Curse Run (treadmill), Closing Storm (battle royale), Maze, Caves, Hazard Zones, Roaming Hazards, Meteor Shower, Safe Zone, or Random (different shape each wave).

default_arena_shape.title: Default Arena Shape
default_arena_shape.description: 0=Default, 1=Circle, 2=Hexagon, 3=Curse Run, 4=Closing Storm, 5=Maze, 6=Caves, 7=Hazard Zones, 8=Roaming Hazards, 9=Meteor Shower, 10=Safe Zone, 11=Random

shrinking_min_scale.title: Closing Storm: Minimum Scale
shrinking_min_scale.description: How small the arena gets (0.3 = 30% of original size)

shrinking_speed.title: Closing Storm: Speed
shrinking_speed.description: How fast the arena shrinks (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast)

meteor_interval.title: Meteor Shower: Interval
meteor_interval.description: Seconds between meteor strikes (lower = more frequent)

meteor_max_active.title: Meteor Shower: Max Active
meteor_max_active.description: How many meteors can be telegraphing at once

default_random_per_run.title: Random: Re-roll Mode
default_random_per_run.description: false = new random shape each wave; true = one random shape per run
